transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Sunday, September 27. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Russia backs India's claim to UNSC seat, firmly shuts door on Germany and Japan. At the recent General Assembly, Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov reaffirmed Russia's support for India and Brazil to secure permanent membership on the UN Security Council. He criticized the prospect of additional seats for Western countries like Germany and Japan, linking it to the West's military actions in Ukraine, which he argues undermine core principles of the UN. He attested brother's sale deed; HC cites oral partition, family loses 3.5 acres claim. The ruling had significant consequences for the children of a family. They ultimately lost their claim over 3.5 acres of ancestral land and were left with only 50 cents. Jaishankar at UNGA: Pakistan serial practitioner of terror, must face outcome. Describing Pakistan as a serial practitioner of terrorism in his UNGA address, foreign minister S Jaishankar said that there must be no dilution of the zero-tolerance approach to the menace. Iran keeps door open for talks as Trump rejects Hormuz proposal. Tehran is awaiting a formal US response to its seven-day proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and end the conflict, Iranian foreign minister Abbas Araghchi said on Sunday, despite US president Donald Trump publicly rejecting the plan. 'Avengers Endgame: Encore' BO day 2: MCU re-release crosses rupees 15 crore mark. Since its debut, Avengers Endgame: Encore has achieved a solid 5.5 percent rise in box office income, netting over rupees 7.65 crore on its second day alone across 3,700 theatres throughout India. Impressively, the English edition led the way in both attendance and profits over other language options. Other recent releases, such as Resident Evil, Primetime, and The Heart of the Beast, are contending for audience attention as well. After meeting, EC says officials will visit homes of those sent notices. A full meeting of the Election Commission of India on Saturday - the first after reports of alleged internal differences - decided to exempt electors who have got notices for being unmapped to the last SIR or over logical discrepancies, from hearings by electoral registration officer (ERO) or assistant EROs. 'SIR decisions unanimous': EC backs decision-making process. Agenda in advance, P 15 4 killed as helicopter crashes in field in Canada's Quebec, probe launched. A helicopter crashed in a field near Montreal, a major city in Canada's Quebec province, on Saturday afternoon, killing all four people on board, Quebec provincial police said. Jamaican contestant Gabrielle Henry speaks out after Miss Universe fall, traumatic brain injury. Jamaican contestant Gabrielle Henry is speaking out nearly a year after she fell nearly five feet from the Miss Universe stage in Bangkok, suffering a traumatic brain injury and other injuries. Henry has filed a lawsuit against the Miss Universe Organization, alleging unsafe stage conditions contributed to the fall and seeking accountability over contestant safety. US immigration authority has a 10-day deadline on home address. USCIS has issued a reminder for immigrants to report changes of address within 10 days of moving. Failing to do so may result in missed notices and delays in immigration cases. Changing addresses with the USPS does not automatically update records with USCIS. Immigrants are encouraged to use the online self-service change-of-address tool for a timely update. 80 aircraft, 40 countries: IAF's Tarang Shakti air exercise kicks off in Jodhpur. NEW DELHI: Nearly 40 countries, 80 aircraft, including 30 foreign fighter jets and transport planes, 1,500 military personnel and one destination: Jodhpur Quote of the day by Liam Payne. In a heartfelt letter to his younger self, Liam Payne reflects on the ups and downs of his remarkable journey. He emphasizes the importance of recognizing the relentless effort required to fulfill one's dreams. Candidly, he recounts his time on The X Factor and forming One Direction, while also confronting personal challenges like self-doubt and insecurity. This letter serves as a powerful reminder to cherish past victories and practice gratitude.
